messages.content: "請問你能告訴我侏羅紀地質時代的推估日期，並計算它是多少年前嗎？另外，你能提供《大憲章》簽署的日期並計算那件事件發生在多少年前嗎？"

function.name: geology_get_era
function.description: Get the estimated date of a geological era. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

era_name.description: The name of the geological era. e.g Ice age

calculate_years_ago.description: True if years ago is to be calculated. False by default

function.name: history_get_event_date
function.description: Get the date of an historical event. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

calculate_years_ago.description: True if years ago is to be calculated. False by default

message.reasoning:
The user asks:

1) "Please tell me the estimated dates of the Jurassic geological era and calculate how many years ago it was." So we need to get the start or end? Usually Jurassic period spans from about 201 million years ago (Ma) to 145 Ma. But they might want the entire range; but likely just the time span.

We can use geology_get_era with era_name="Jurassic". We also set calculate_years_ago=true maybe returns something like "Approximately X years ago".

2) Provide the signing date of Magna Carta ("Great Charter") and compute how many years ago it happened. That would be 1215 AD. Use history_get_event_date with event_name="Magna Carta", calculate_years_ago true.

We'll call both functions accordingly.

Let's do first function call: geology_get_era({"era_name":"Jurassic","calculate_years_ago":true})

Second: history_get_event_date({"event_name":"Magna Carta","calculate_years_ago":true})

Then respond with results.
